ingredients: Sliced onions (for diced remove 5 mins cook time, but add 5 mins prep time)
instructions: Heat wide pan with oil. I like avocado oil because it has a high smoke point.
Once pan is hot — but before it smokes — add the onions.
Gradually add seasonings as you cook. This allows gradual caramelization, and you can season to taste.
recipes.title: Caramelized Onions

ingredients: Pickling spices (fennel, mustard seeds, nigella seeds)
instructions: Heat mustard oil until it smokes slightly, then let it cool a bit.
Temper the pickling spices in the oil.
Add ginger, garlic, and the cauliflower.
Sauté until tender and coated with the aromatic spices.
recipes.title: Achari Gobhi

ingredients: Red onions and tomatoes, sliced thick
Soy sauce and aji amarillo paste
French fries (served mixed in or on the side)
instructions: Sear the beef quickly in a very hot wok or skillet. Remove and set aside.
Stir-fry the onions and tomatoes until slightly softened but still crisp.
Add the beef back in along with soy sauce and aji amarillo.
Serve immediately over rice with french fries.
recipes.title: Lomo Saltado

ingredients: Napa cabbage, finely chopped and squeezed dry
Ginger, soy sauce, and sesame oil
instructions: Mix the filling ingredients thoroughly in one direction.
Place a small spoonful of filling in the center of a wrapper.
Wet the edges with water, fold, and pleat to seal.
Pan-fry, boil, or steam until cooked through.
